title: Digiwell Marketing · Email strategy and implementation

slides.notes: Category first: email strategy and implementation for expert-led businesses. The promise is a clear next step for people who already showed interest. AI is how the work gets done, not the pitch.
Four parts: the problem, why one journey, how we work, where to start. It ends in a conversation, not a pitch.
Section 01. The problem lives after someone shows interest, not before.
The thesis. Let line two land. Describe the gap from their side: people subscribe, enquire, then hear nothing useful.
One question per click. Ask, then pause. These are questions, not a diagnosis of them. No stats here until proof is approved.
One card per click. This is a choice, not a bundle: every build is one journey. Ask which one matters most to them.
Fit conversation, scoped build, test and their sign-off, handover. Ongoing help is scoped separately, never assumed.
Left column is the lived pain. Right column is what they can count on. No outcome promises: no leads, revenue or inbox placement.
One ask: let's talk about your email. We'll see where things stand and whether there's a useful first project. Leave this up.
